notices.summary_row: Written contract contents, over $1,000, nine items, complaint statement rule
notices.hold_reason: no prescribed wording; the statute only lists required content

notices.title: NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form, in duplicate
notices.format: Completed form in duplicate, attached to the contract or receipt, in the language of the oral sales presentation
notices.support: the following completed form, in duplicate and in the language used in the oral sales presentation which, if in English, would be in the form set forth in this subsection, is attached to the contract or receipt
notices.summary_row: NOTICE TO BUYER and NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form, same-language rule
notices.block: A.R.S. 44-5004. Agreement requirements (NOTICE TO BUYER and NOTICE OF CANCELLATION)
notices.quote_note: none: the form follows 'the following completed form, in duplicate ... is attached to the contract or receipt:' and is not in quotation marks.
blanks: /enter date of transaction/ with the line ' (date) ' under it
not later than midnight of ____________________ with ' (date)' under it
notices.boundary_unsure: Start is the caption NOTICE OF CANCELLATION right after the statute's lead-in sentence ending 'in the form set forth in this subsection, is attached to the contract or receipt:'; end is the last line '(buyer's signature)' which is the last line of the block. The statute's own bracket-style placeholders (/enter date of transaction/, {name of seller}) are kept exactly as printed. The statute gives no blank after 'NOT LATER THAN MIDNIGHT OF' beyond the underscores shown.

notices.title: NOTICE TO BUYER (five points)
notices.trigger: Home solicitation sale: seller personally solicits without prior invitation and the buyer's agreement is made at a home other than the seller's
notices.format: Conspicuous, in the language of the oral sales presentation; agreement must be dated and signed by the buyer
notices.support: No agreement of the buyer in a home solicitation sale shall be effective unless it is dated, signed by the buyer and contains a conspicuous notice in the language used in the oral sales presentation
notices.summary_row: NOTICE TO BUYER and NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form, same-language rule
notices.block: A.R.S. 44-5004. Agreement requirements (NOTICE TO BUYER and NOTICE OF CANCELLATION)
notices.end: to repossess goods purchased under this agreement.
notices.quote_note: none: the notice follows 'which if in English would be as follows:' and is not in quotation marks.
notices.boundary_unsure: Start is the caption NOTICE TO BUYER after 'contains a conspicuous notice ... which if in English would be as follows:'; end is the end of numbered item 5, the last item before subsection C. No judgement about the end was needed; the five numbered points are the whole notice.

notices.title: Pool safety notice handed to the buyer
notices.trigger: Agreement to build a swimming pool or contained body of water
notices.format: A notice explaining safety education and responsibilities of pool ownership as approved by the Department of Health Services
notices.support: A person on entering into an agreement to build a swimming pool or contained body of water or sell, rent or lease a dwelling with a swimming pool or contained body of water shall give the buyer, lessee or renter a notice explaining safety education and responsibilities of pool ownership as approved by the department of health services.
notices.summary_row: Department of Health Services approved pool safety notice (the document itself)
notices.hold_reason: the Department of Health Services approved pool safety notice itself was not obtained; the statute states a duty only

notices.title: Statement on the face of any note given in a home solicitation sale
notices.trigger: Each note or other evidence of indebtedness given by a buyer in a home solicitation sale
notices.format: Conspicuous statement on the face of the note (not in the contract)
notices.support: Each note or other evidence of indebtedness given by a buyer in respect of a home solicitation sale shall bear on its face a conspicuous statement as follows
notices.summary_row: Statement on any note taken in a home solicitation sale
notices.block: A.R.S. 44-5005(B). Statement on any note or evidence of indebtedness
notices.start: This instrument is based upon a home solicitation sale
notices.quote_note: The statute's opening quotation mark (before 'This instrument') and closing mark (after 'not negotiable.') are excluded by placing the markers inside them.

notices.title: Registrar complaint provision in a contract for sale of a newly constructed dwelling
notices.trigger: Written contract for the sale of a newly constructed dwelling by the seller responsible for the original construction
notices.format: Prominently displayed, at least ten point bold type; buyer initials the provision
notices.support: A written contract for the sale of a newly constructed dwelling between a buyer of a newly constructed dwelling and the seller responsible for the original construction of the dwelling shall contain, or provide separate notice of, the following provision
notices.block: A.R.S. 12-1365. New-dwelling notice (new construction sellers only)
notices.quote_note: none: the provision follows 'the following provision:' and is not in quotation marks.

notices.title: Preliminary twenty day notice statement (sent by subcontractors and suppliers)
notices.trigger: Served by a lien claimant within twenty days of first furnishing; not a contract clause
notices.format: Bold-faced type statement in the claimant's notice
notices.support: The following statement in bold-faced type:
notices.summary_row: Preliminary twenty day notice statement (sent by subs and suppliers, not a contract clause)
notices.block: A.R.S. 33-992.01(C)(5). Preliminary twenty day notice statement
notices.start: In accordance with Arizona Revised Statutes section 33-992.01
notices.end: that is appropriate under the circumstances.

changes.new: Three business days (44-5002); NOTICE TO BUYER and NOTICE OF CANCELLATION form are in 44-5004
changes.support: The form is not in 44-5003 at all.
the contract, receipt and all other documents pertaining to the contract are written in the same language used in the oral sales presentation

changes.new: Sundays and nine named federal holidays are not business days; Saturday counts (44-5002(A)).
changes.support: Sundays and nine named federal holidays are excluded from "business day" but Saturday is not

unsure: AZ-registrar: 32-1158(A)(9) lists required content (registrar phone and website, the two-year time limit) with no sentence; the phone and website were not obtained (Registrar site returned 403).
A.R.S. 44-5005(B) statement on a note was not added: it goes on the face of a note, not in the contract, and depends on a note being taken.
A.R.S. 12-1365 new-dwelling notice was not added: it is for sales of newly constructed dwellings only, not remodel contracts.

AZ-cancel and AZ-notice-to-buyer are now printed with applies sold_in_home; the statute covers only sales solicited without prior invitation, appointment or consent (44-5001(1)(a)), which the builder cannot tell, so sold_in_home is the closest test (it may print for an invited visit).
AZ-pool-notice stays held: the Department of Health Services notice itself was not obtained; the statute states a duty only.

AZ-note-statement, AZ-new-dwelling, AZ-prelim-20day: stored on file only; the first goes on a note, the second applies to new-home sales only, the third is a lien claimant's notice, none belongs in a remodel contract text.
AZ-cancel and AZ-notice-to-buyer apply only to sales solicited without prior invitation; the builder can only test sold_in_home.
